name: Rail
summary: Things side by side in one row that scrolls sideways, each the same width: deals on a home page, related products, category chips, a row of stories (Q139 R3). The row bleeds to the surface's edge and scrolls in a ScrollArea (Q96), with each item's focus ring unclipped. Not for a full listing someone compares or searches (use Grid, so everything shows without scrolling), or one picture at a time (use Carousel).
a11y: A list, named by `label` when given, so assistive technology says how many items there are. Tab moves through the items' own controls and the ScrollArea keeps the focused one in view; nothing is reachable only by scrolling.

props.name: label
props.description: The list's name for assistive technology: "Today's best deals". Leave it out when a named `nav` or region around the rail already says it.

props.name: item
props.description: Each item's width: `s` (176 px) small cards many to a view, `m` (default, 256 px) cards, `l` (320 px) wide cards, `auto` as wide as its content (chips, links). The same steps as Grid `min`.

props.name: gap
props.description: The space between items: `group` (default) between cards, `item` between chips or links.

props.name: bar
props.description: The row's scrollbar: `overlay` (default) the library's thin bar over the row's foot, shown on hover and while scrolling; `line` a progress line under the row, shown whenever it overflows (Q141, a shop's rail of offers).

props.name: children
props.description: The items, each one card, chip or link; the rail puts each in a list item.
